control.description-key: Virtual PCF: form-bound viewer for the shared CommunicationTimeline component in regarding mode (task 020) on the 11 ADR-024 regarding-family entity forms (sprk_matter, sprk_project, sprk_invoice, sprk_servicerequest, sprk_workassignment, sprk_event, sprk_budget, sprk_analysis, sprk_organization, account, contact). Resolves the host records (entityType, id) from the Xrm page context and renders that records threads as collapsible groups (name + message count), each expanding to the R1 interleaved timeline, polling the BFF by-regarding endpoint via @spaarke/auth. Read-only, no compose box (composing stays in thread-id mode, the sibling CommunicationTimeline PCF). No Code Page host, no FCC swap (ADR-026 Path-A exception; task 021).

property.name: anchorField
property.description-key: Bind to the record primary Name field. Anchors the control to the form; the control reads the record (entityType, id) from context, not from this value.

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Azure AD application (client) ID for PCF MSAL authentication

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: BFF API application ID for OAuth scope construction

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer.
